author: David Bombal
description:
What turns a language model into an AI agent? Jensen Huang shares why OpenClaw caught his attention and explains how NVIDIA approaches agent security with OpenShell, zero trust, minimum privileges and continuous monitoring.

Thank you to NVIDIA for sponsoring this video and my trip to GTC Berlin!

#JensenHuang #NVIDIAGTC #AgenticAI
title: Jensen Huang Explains the Next Step for AI
